caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular fragment of patterned fabric with a symmetrical design featuring alternating vertical panels. The background color of the fabric appears to be a muted beige or off-white, with the pattern primarily in shades of red-orange, black, white, and brown. The two outer vertical bands display swirling, ornate leaf and floral motifs in red-orange, outlined in black, set against a pale background with intricate dotted details and small blue accents. The central vertical band is wider and has a brown background with a repeating oval frame containing stylized birds and baskets holding flowers, depicted in a combination of red, white, black, and blue. Thin vertical borders with a repeating dot or floral motif in red, white, and blue separate these panels. The whole composition is set against a blank, light-colored surface, with the edges of the fabric fragment visible and slightly uneven.
title: Historical Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
